issue.title: Explicit session/turn targets for fork and agent waits
issue.description: `#fork:<name>` reliably waits for the whole agent session, even when the parent is promoted into a session after the fork launched. Users can explicitly choose `session` or `turn` with `#fork(<name>, target=session|turn)`, `%wait(<name>, target=session|turn)`, `sase agent wait -T`, and the plan-gate coder options. Admission and injected fork history agree on the same bound target.
